propositions: Dedicated DC summary executor must construct a client with max_retries=0 via jira.JIRA() and reject nonzero session values.

Each write invocation must issue exactly GET, PUT, GET in sequence; pre-mutation GET fault ends with request_count=1 as retryable or permanent; PUT fault ends with request_count=2 and commit_unknown classification.

Successful PUT triggers read-back GET; outcome is applied (request_count=3) only if observed summary equals intended summary; mismatch or GET failure yields commit_unknown (request_count=3) without auto-replay.

After ambiguous PUT, a separate single-attempt GET under shared budget is mapped through decide_replay: desired observation (summary matches) recovers without further write; conclusive old state (summary present but mismatched) permits remaining-budget replay; failed or inconclusive GET returns non-replaying commit_unknown.

Every DC terminal or cleanup failure must emit exactly one redacted completion log containing logical id, disposition, invocation and request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one message capped at 512 Unicode code points; whole log at most 1,024 Unicode code points.
Injected one-attempt/no-sleep policy applied to selected executor calls via _with_connection_retry; legacy wrapper behavior and SDK retry path remain unchanged.
